CA.rationale: Content (red positions) is explicitly identified and an origin/process entry links processing/change to that same content/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) is identified, its presentation is given as coordinate listings, and an origin/status field separately marks its representation status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Origin entries describe processing/estimation/feedback applied to specific candidate contents, linking a processing/change condition to those contents' representation.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content (color-labeled cell sets) with coordinate tuples.

D.rationale: Origin metadata separately distinguishes content identity from its representation/origin/status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report specifies how the grid coordinates map to orientation and lists spatial positions, describing how content is presented/organized.
